name: Blizzard
description: Buries a target within %cast_range% tiles in snow, rooting it and dealing %damage% damage per turn for %duration% turns. Re-casting it on an already-buried target extends the duration.

upgrade.summary: The snow disarms as well as roots.
details: A buried unit is disarmed for the whole duration on top of being rooted - it cannot swing its way out either.
A Snow Golem's Blizzard Fist and Snow Blast bury their victims the same way, disarm included.
